source.approved_retrieval: use unchanged v2 exact-host official Dryad transfer + member verified source in archived EOG code; no new host, no source version switch

audit_goal: Explain numerical source-coordinate/georeference disagreement with reported distances; do not score animal movement, retune original radius, choose best posthoc mapping, or repair original scientific STOP

eligibility.unit: original CSV row (QC only, not independent animals)
eligibility.include: nonempty Toad ID and Date of re-encounter, complete six original coordinate columns, at least one numeric reported distance column
eligibility.delete: byte-identical CSV duplicate rows only, exact existing v1 source grain contract
eligibility.missing_policy: same exact tokens as frozen v1, no imputation or outcome-based filtering
eligibility.cap: 165 publisher rows; fail closed if more

frozen_pair_definitions.IR: Initial Easting/Northing minus Released Easting/Northing Euclidean norm
frozen_pair_definitions.RF: Released Easting/Northing minus Final Easting/Northing Euclidean norm
frozen_pair_definitions.IF: Initial Easting/Northing minus Final Easting/Northing Euclidean norm

comparison_grid.compare_as: reported distance versus multiplier * Euclidean(candidate pair), original coordinates and candidate distance columns not edited
comparison_grid.match_tolerance: max(2 m, 0.05*computed scaled candidate distance); same frozen original numeric concordance threshold
comparison_grid.report: per-column×pair×multiplier: eligible numeric rows, matched rows, share, median absolute residual (m), q90 absolute residual (m), min and max reported positive values if allowable aggregated; no individual values/labels
comparison_grid.zero_division: if no valid values, status NOT_ESTIMABLE, never PASS
comparison_grid.note: All 18 options predeclared as *diagnostic alternatives only*. Highest matching cell cannot retrospectively replace the original comparison or release v1 STOP
comparison_grid.privacy_rule: If fewer than five numerical row comparisons exist in any cell, retain matched_count/total and match_fraction but set median/q90 residual to null; never expose single-record numeric residual

quality_controls: Do not modify original v1 toad analysis/test/receipt, even if alternative diagnostic maps seem better.
Do not infer directional homing, sign, biological effect, dispersal or origin from these diagnostics.
Retain entire denominator and per-column missingness; do not delete mismatch rows or improve threshold.
Require original SHA256/byte count and pinned official version before processing.
All coordinate values and reported distances read transiently only within runner; never commit/export row coordinates, Toad IDs, full source ZIP/CSV or per-event scores.
Use source analytic STOP if not enough complete quality rows, no numeric distance, or no credible mapping; output partial diagnostics but no ecological verdict.
An apparent match under nonidentity pair/scale is an annotation hypothesis only; not corrected scientific source by itself.
No fresh EOG-WF endpoint, frozen denominator 3 scored /31 scientific STOP/3 administrative exclusions.
pre_execution_amendment: Aggregated output privacy protection added before first real source execution; comparison pairs, scales, thresholds, sample selection and STOP are unchanged.
